lines: Seriously, my heart's thumping.
I love you so much I'm dying!
Crazy, crazy—this love is crazy.
I’m sorry, I can no longer endure.
Crazy, crazy—it's the craziest ever.
Prove that this isn’t a dream?
I was reborn into this world.
Ushiwakamaru, Yang Guifei.
It fills my mind completely.
That smile hijacks my hippocampus.
Love can’t be expressed in simple words.
I can’t put this feeling away.
I’ll give you everything I have.
If it makes you happy…
I never knew I existed like this until today.
You are a mystery, you are a mystery.
Stay by my side forever.
“Eh, I love you.”
Seriously, my heart's thumping.
I love you so much I'm dying!
My heart rate is soaring.
Just live healthily.
That alone makes me happy.
Seriously, my heart's thumping.
I love you so much I'm dying!
How far do you intend to make me fall?
Ah, to think you’re nonfiction.
I have no reason, I have no heart.
All day, all night, I'm smitten.
I want to stare only at you.
I could toss everything away without a problem.
In reality, I can’t stop this feeling.
What on earth have I become?
Will you let me keep loving you now and forever?
At the farthest edge of the universe, we met.
Stars glitter, love burns.
We blend together—truly love.
I won’t miss any version of you.
I want to capture every you in my eyes.
My exclusive camera roll.
I want to have you all to myself.
I won’t give away my treasure.
“No… maybe?”
A one‑in‑8‑billion miracle.
Drops of love wet the earth.
Flowers, birds, wind, and the moon
are calling your name.
I love you, I love you, I love you, I love you.
Seriously, my heart's thumping.
I love you so much I'm dying!
How far do you intend to make me fall?
Ah, to think you’re nonfiction.
Come to me in dreams, wake me with a kiss.
“I won’t let go.” “I’ll protect you.”
Let us vow eternity here and now.
